claims.disproof_condition: 條件：HCE 的 DART 出現這份合約的정정或해지公示，或 ERock 的 10-Q／10-K／8-K 寫出長缸體供應合約終止、改向別家採購或交期延後。核查頻率：每季（HCE 的 DART 公示；ERock 10-Q）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註或降 confidence，重寫 ERock 敘事的位置段與錯的訊號。
claims.statement: Supplier-side regulatory disclosure (HD Construction Equipment, DART single sales/supply contract filing, 2026-10-07): a supply contract for engine long blocks for gas power generation with Enchanted Rock, supply region United States, KRW 387.9 billion (USD 285,555,690 at the contract-date rate), term 2027-01-01 to 2028-12-31, 10% advance payment and 90% billed as supply proceeds, signed 2026-10-06; the amount equals 10.27% of the pre-merger 2025 consolidated revenue. Same contract form and terms as the PSI contract filed 2026-11-10.
